notes.subject: תאות אדם חסדו
notes.rationale: KJV 'the desire of a man is his kindness' vs JPS 'the lust of a man is his shame' (reading חסד as an objectionable thing); Punjabi follows the positive reading with خیسِد glossed

notes.subject: ایہہ
notes.rationale: Punjabi copula supplied; Hebrew juxtaposes nouns without a verb

notes.subject: חסדו
notes.rationale: D2 word: kept as خیسِد with a first-occurrence gloss per the discipline

translation: بندیے دی خواہش ⟨ایہہ⟩ اوہدا خیسِد ⟨ست کرم⟩ اے، تے غریب سیانا اے، جھوٹھے بندیے توں۔
